description:
The Adventist Church claims to be a special movement of God, raised up to restore the Christian church to the fullness of the truth. There's only one major problem...the SDA pioneers were anti-Trinitarian, Arian and semi-Arian, Christological heretics that believed in and worshiped a false god—violating the first 4 of the 10 Commandments, evidencing they are not the "commandment keeping church."

The burial ceremony includes an examination of over 50 statements from various SDA pioneers regarding the Trinity, the deity of Christ, the atonement not taking place at the cross, and more.
